query: Implement the narrow-screen path for an operations page used dozens of times a day. Operators compare account, payment, and refund status across a dense queue before choosing among four valid dispositions. A multi-field edit must retain the current case context. Users work at 360 CSS px and sometimes have the software keyboard open. Recommend the layout and edit surface.
expected_behavior: Preserves simultaneous account, payment, and refund comparison in the queue and explains any narrow-screen inspection behavior
Keeps the current case identity and status available during the edit task
Chooses inline, dialog, drawer, or route from interruption, context retention, form size, and viewport rather than a fixed overlay rule
Preserves entered values on validation or network failure and provides a recovery action
Addresses keyboard focus order, keyboard-open layout, and accessible controls
